title: Swollen Members -  "Lady Venom" Live @  Electric Daisy Carnival 2004
description:
Taking it back to the early days of EDC where Hip Hop was heavily incorporated into the festival. This was also the lead in to the iconic Rock The Bells Festival which ran from 2004 - 2013.

Along with Swollen Members, this stage also featured Living Legends, Visionaries, Planet Asia, AWOL One, and MC Supernatural.
